description: This Java class implements the User Data Access Object (DAO) for SQL databases, providing methods to query and manage User entities within the Thingsboard platform. It includes methods for finding users by email, tenant, authority, and other criteria, as well as counting users and retrieving batches.

classes.name: JpaUserDao
classes.description: A DAO class for managing User entities in a SQL database, implementing UserDao interface with methods for user retrieval, counting, and batch processing.

methods.name: getEntityClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of the UserEntity.

methods.name: findByEmail
methods.description: Finds a User by email within a tenant.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndEmail
methods.description: Finds a User by tenant ID and email.

methods.name: findByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves users by tenant ID with pagination.

methods.name: findTenantAdmins
methods.description: Retrieves tenant admin users with pagination.

methods.name: findCustomerUsers
methods.description: Retrieves users associated with a specific customer.

methods.name: findUsersByCustomerIds
methods.description: Retrieves users associated with multiple customer IDs.

methods.name: findAllByAuthority
methods.description: Retrieves users by authority with pagination.

methods.name: findByAuthorityAndTenantsIds
methods.description: Retrieves users by authority and list of tenant IDs.

methods.name: findByAuthorityAndTenantProfilesIds
methods.description: Retrieves users by authority and tenant profile IDs.

methods.name: findUserAuthDetailsByUserId
methods.description: Retrieves user authentication details by user ID.

methods.name: countTenantAdmins
methods.description: Counts the number of tenant admin users.

methods.name: findUsersByTenantIdAndIds
methods.description: Finds users by tenant ID and list of user IDs.

methods.name: findAllByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves all users for a tenant ID.

methods.name: findNextBatch
methods.description: Retrieves the next batch of UserFields.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type, which is USER.
